{{Quote|Gonk, gonk.|W1-EG5|<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''W1-EG5''' was a [[Color|white]] [[Maintenance droid|repair droid]] that was forced to work in the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel|mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the event on Kessel in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> W1-EG5 was freed from [[slavery]] when its [[restraining bolt]] was removed during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in the [[Mining|mines]] started by the [[droid]] [[L3-37]]. Shortly after his freedom, the spunky droid used its moving flap as a fist against the Pyke Syndicate's control room.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
W1-EG5 first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TOG" /> The droid was one of several characters in the film portrayed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Warwick Davis]].<ref name="Five More Along Weazel">{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/warwick-davis-interview-solo-star-wars-story|text=Warwick Davis Interview: Solo: A Star Wars Story|author=Leadbeater, Alex|date=2018-09-25|quote=I was also another droid in that control room who gets released and goes a bit crazy, whacking his tray - he's like a Gonk droid so he's whacking a tray along the consoles.|archivedate=20181006054346}}</ref>
